historical_record.description: By 1914 the Reinhart Lumber & Planing Mill Company filled the whole site with industrial buildings, in a district of iron works, a fuel oil company, a soap factory and a glycerin maker.
The S&C Ford Service Center, a steel-framed car repair building of about 85,000 square feet that covered the whole site, was demolished.

The City Planning Commission certified the supplemental environmental impact report for the 450 Rhode Island Street residential development with retail and the 17th and Rhode Island Streets grocery store special use subdistrict legislation.

The City Planning Commission approved conditional use authorization for a planned unit development of up to 168 dwelling units with commercial and retail space, including a grocery store, at 450 Rhode Island Street.
